setup_batch_predict_server: build a Ray Serve deployment for batched MLIP inference with configurable batch size and OOM splitting
BatchPredictServer_predict: run batched predictions on a list of AtomicData objects with automatic OOM batch splitting
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the maximum batch size and wait timeout for the batched prediction server
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into individual per-system and per-atom prediction dictionaries
BatchPredictServer_get_predict_unit_attr: retrieve any attribute from the underlying MLIP predict unit by name
